policy: Only sources with currently usable public inspiration material are active. An account may be used only when the user is authorized to use it; access controls, paywalls, security interstitials, and private content are never bypassed. Sources marked inactive remain as an audit trail and cannot be selected for a project dossier. Each active source declares how its entries can actually be retrieved: 'fetch' means a plain HTTP request exposes entry links and images, 'browser' means entries render only in a real browser session, so a plain fetch that returns a script shell or a rate-limit response is not evidence that the source is unavailable.

sources.name: Awwwards
sources.scope: Public website awards, nominees, winners, and category browsing.
sources.notes: Public listing and detail material was visible during the 2026-09-01 audit. Entry pages expose the live site link and a preview image to a plain fetch.

sources.name: Godly
sources.scope: Public cross-discipline visual and interface inspiration; the current endpoint may redirect to Recent.
sources.notes: Public design browsing was visible during the 2026-09-01 audit. A plain fetch returns a script shell with no entry links; use a real browser session.

sources.name: Mobbin
sources.scope: Publicly visible app, web, UI-element, flow, and pattern examples.
sources.notes: Use only examples and detail visible without sign-in; paid or account-only material cannot be selected. Entries render only in a real browser session.

sources.name: SiteInspire
sources.scope: Public website gallery with category, style, type, and subject filters.
sources.notes: Public entries and filters were visible during the 2026-09-01 audit. The site rate-limits plain requests (HTTP 429); use a real browser session at a human pace and never work around the limit.
